detail.longDescription: Six domains behind public MCP server listings were unregistered and could be bought for $4 a year. Buy one and any agent still configured to call it now talks to you. OX Security checked 15,465 MCP servers across 5,095 hostnames; 2.3% of the hostnames no longer resolve at all. Treat MCP endpoints like dependencies: pin them, and re-check they still belong to who you think. https://www. ox.security/ebooks/15465-mcp-s ervers-0-governance/ # AIAgents # MCP # Cybersecurity
